card.title: Xbox One Controller Analog stick drift or jumping around repair

source.title: Xbox One Controller Analog stick drift or jumping around repair

claims.statement: Xbox One controller drift: clean then replace the four pots; there are green (ALPS) and orange pot types that are only swappable like-for-like because of shaft size; centre replacements before soldering.

procedure: Replace with same colour/type pot, centred.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
